verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST Cloud API to launch, create and manage instances (lambda-labs-docs-5, lambda-labs-docs-31). A community-built tool on that API can launch and terminate instances (lambda-labs-comm-1), and ODC bills hourly usage in one-minute increments (lambda-labs-docs-10). A user's report of being billed for an idle instance they forgot to terminate (lambda-labs-comm-2) confirms that billing runs until termination, with no idle distinction. missing for 10: documented stop and restart operations, a documented first-party terminate endpoint, and evidence of a stopped state that halts billing while preserving the instance.
